Re-run 17:03. (a) both modes, thrown and 'unreadable': error shown, button back to 'Photograph', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry works — but the error has no role=alert / live region (fails U15). 产品问题: (1) A failed photo read is not announced to assistive technology (no role=alert / live region), and when the read service errors the physician reads '[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error Uncaught Error: Vertex AI request failed: 404 …' (TC-13 U15). descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B17 · P1 · 新

出错时直接把服务器原始报错给医生看（「[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] … Server Error … 404」）；识图失败时还会把 AI 服务商的原文（可能带 Google 项目 / 服务账号）传到浏览器

票：TFA-94745 ready for qa；TFA-94425 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-05/S30

思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S28 「AI 失败时：读照片报错、提取主模型失败，以及面板在桌面和手机上的非默认状态」 When the AI fails: photo read error, extraction primary-model failure, and the panel's non-default states on desktop and phone

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U15 When a photo read or an extraction fails or is slow, the app retries and then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message that is announced to assistive technology. …（UAT 3.5） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U1 Paste and photograph are physician-triggered only. Nothing is read, extracted or written to the chart until the physician pastes or photographs a prior note and saves it, and no prior note is pulled …（UAT TC-13；TFA-92591 AC 6；TFA-92591 How it works 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital and Nursing Home Pre-Round. ai/vision:scanPriorNote is mocked to fail (like dev's Vertex 404 before PR #102), and on the local stack the primary extraction model is forced to fail

When (a) Photograph → the read fails. (b) Paste → Save & Extract while the primary model fails. (c) Run axe and the phone checks (pixel7, iphone15) with the Paste form open, a saved note expanded, and the photo error shown

Then (a) A clear error appears and is announced (role=alert or a live region). The button leaves 'Reading', nothing is saved, Paste still works and Photograph can be retried. (b) aiCallLog shows a fallback row (Mistral Large 3) and the fields fill without a tap; or, once retries are exhausted, a clear message appears and the pasted note is kept. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.5 ('retries, then switches to the backup model or shows a clear message; never left waiting with nothing') + 3.9 + WCAG 2 A/AA (axe-core violations = 0, visual-checks.ts). On main the photo error line has no role=alert (the extraction error line has one), so a finding is expected

在哪跑：本地 newspec-b（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S28 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92591 in progress；TFA-94745 ready for qa

旧笔记拍照识别在服务端失败时，医生看到的是原始服务器报错（「[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error … Vertex AI request failed: 404」），而且读屏不会播报这个错误。

When a prior-note photo read fails on the server, the physician sees raw server text ('[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error … Vertex AI request failed: 404'), and the error is not announced to a screen reader.

依据：allure 38253418. (a) The error shows, nothing is saved, and Paste and retry work, but there is no role=alert and a thrown read shows the raw text. (b) Extraction falls back from Haiku x2 to Mistral and fills the fields (pass). (c) Accessibility: low-contrast heading, date and note fields labelled only by placeholder, and on phones the 'Note · <date>' toggle is 276×16 px and the delete button 21×21 px. The raw text breaks TFA-94745 AC 2 / EFS U12 (ungated; EFS S19 not built) and is not in the dev report, the ledger or any knownGaps. The gate for U15 is TFA-92591 (in progress). Observation: a photo read after a saved paste appends to the old paste text.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-b。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-b。

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S28

When the AI fails: photo read error, extraction primary-model failure, and the panel's non-default states on desktop and phone

Tickets: TFA-92591 Previous Notes (carry-forward template) (in progress)

本地新 lane newspec-b：newspec-b/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（newspec-b/plan.json，automatable: partly）：(a) Chromium: ai/vision:scanPriorNote answered with a failure at the socket after a photo upload (synthetic image); assert a clear error with role=alert or a live region, button leaves 'Reading', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry possible. (b) In-process api harness: real extractPriorNote handler with Haiku failing (throttle ×2) → Mistral answers, diagnostics row model=Mistral fellBackFrom=Haiku; plus UI: Save & Extract fills fields without a tap when the action answers. (c) axe WCAG 2 A/AA + phone checks (pixel7, iphone15 emulation) on Paste form open, a saved note expanded, the photo error shown. After review: (c) also runs axe's target-size rule (WCAG 2.5.8, size or spacing) on the panel; the size-only pageChecks is reported as the matrix's ≥ 24 px rule, not as 2.5.8. — (b) cannot fail the primary model on the live local backend without aiProvider:_set / env set (out of bounds), so the fallback is proven at the provider seam in-process, not end to end; everything else is scripted. Patch keeps needs ['fault-ai'] for that part (check-matrix has no 'partly' testability).

Detail:

Re-run 17:03. (a) both modes, thrown and 'unreadable': error shown, button back to 'Photograph', nothing saved, Paste works, Photograph retry works — but the error has no role=alert / live region (fails U15). The thrown read shows the raw server text (the mock mimics dev's Vertex 404; the app prints it verbatim). (b) Hospital passes: 'Prior note saved, but extraction failed. Expand it and tap Extract Fields to retry.' (role=alert), note kept; Extract Fields then fills imaging/background with no further tap. The primary-model fallback is proven in-process only (extractPriorNote Haiku ×2 → Mistral, diagnostics row Mistral fellBackFrom Haiku with providerMs); end to end it needs aiProvider:_set (out of bounds), so (b) is partly covered. Nursing Home stores the note with no extraction (Q4, recorded). (c) axe color-contrast (serious) on the panel heading in every state and view; date and note fields labelled only by placeholders; under the matrix's ≥ 24 px size rule the 'Note · <date>' toggle (276×16) and the delete button (21×21) are too small on Pixel 7 / iPhone 15 — but axe's target-size rule (WCAG 2.5.8, which allows the spacing exception) finds 0 violations in every state and view, so this is not a WCAG 2.5.8 failure. No sideways scroll, nothing truncated or covered.

产品问题：(1) A failed photo read is not announced to assistive technology (no role=alert / live region), and when the read service errors the physician reads '[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] [Request ID: …] Server Error Uncaught Error: Vertex AI request failed: 404 …' (TC-13 U15). (2) Previous Notes panel: low-contrast heading (axe color-contrast, WCAG 1.4.3) and placeholder-only labels on the date and note fields (WCAG 1.3.1/3.3.2) — TC-13 S28 oracle. Tap targets under the matrix's 24 px rule (16 px-high toggle, 21 px delete) on phones; axe target-size passes (spacing exception), so this is the matrix's rule, not WCAG 2.5.8. Observation: after a pasted note is saved, a photo read appends to the old text in the paste box (the note appears twice).

证据：附了 6 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our mocked Playwright test and visual-lane states, not written yet): it mocks ai/vision:scanPriorNote with action-observer.ts, needs a local switch that fails the primary extraction model (aiProvider:_set and convex env set are out of bounds) and a make-session.ts fixture for the visual l…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
